prerequisites: Fundamentals of Electricity, Electronics and Automation
syllabus_topics: Poles and zeros of a system
Influence of plant model uncertainty and external disturbances
Experimental tuning of PID parameters using the Ziegler-Nichols method
Graphical representation of frequency response: The Bode plot
Controller tuning using the Bode plot
SYSTEM MODELING, SIMULATION, AND CONTROL USING MATLAB / SIMULINK
teaching_methods: Resolution of practical cases in the laboratory
Student study based on different sources of information
Explanation of the use of useful computer tools (Matlab / Simulink)
assessment_rules: The final grade will be the better of two options: a weighted average of practical cases (10%) and the ordinary final exam (90%), or the ordinary final exam alone (100%). This same rule applies to the extraordinary call, substituting the ordinary exam with the extraordinary exam. Any attempt at fraud, copying, or plagiarism is considered a serious infraction. Students with special educational needs should contact the Tecnun Study Coordination in advance for authorized adaptations.
